tools.name: search_inventory
tools.description: Search available liquidation inventory with filters

tools.name: get_product_details
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific product

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Request a bulk quote for a product (buyer tool). Works without credentials: buyer_email is required and is where the seller replies. Anonymous quotes are limited to 5 per hour per IP; a buyer X-Agent-Token binds the quote to the buyer's account instead.

tools.name: get_quote_status
tools.description: Read back a quote you filed: status (pending, responded, accepted, rejected, completed), the seller's price and shipping once they reply, and what to do next. Pass the status_token request_quote returned; a buyer X-Agent-Token or account key can read its own quotes without one.

tools.name: create_listing
tools.description: Create a new product listing (seller tool)

tools.name: get_pricing_recommendation
tools.description: Get AI-powered pricing recommendation for inventory (seller tool)

tools.name: get_quote_requests
tools.description: Get pending quote requests for seller's products (seller tool)

tools.name: respond_to_quote
tools.description: Respond to a buyer's quote request (seller tool)

tools.name: bulk_update_listings
tools.description: Bulk update prices or minimum order quantities across up to 200 of the calling seller's product listings. Thin adapter over POST /api/products/bulk-update-price and /bulk-update-moq — same seller-ownership filter and per-product validation. Choose mode='price_set' (value=USD), 'price_percent_increas

tools.name: bulk_mark_shipped
tools.description: Mark up to 200 of the calling seller's orders as shipped, optionally writing a shared tracking number / URL / carrier to every order. Thin adapter over POST /api/seller/orders/bulk-mark-shipped — same per-order ownership filter, auto-detected carrier when only a tracking number is supplied. Supplyin

tools.name: bulk_export_orders
tools.description: Export the calling seller's orders as CSV (Order ID, Product, Buyer, Quantity, Total, Status, Date). Thin adapter over POST /api/seller/orders/bulk-export — orders not owned by the caller are silently skipped. Returns the CSV body as a string plus the suggested filename.

tools.name: seller_inbox_summarise
tools.description: Read-only digest of the calling seller's inbox: pending quote requests, orders at risk of missing their ship-by deadline, and orders with reported issues. Useful for a daily standup or cron-driven agent that decides which bulk action to run next.

tools.name: quick_buy
tools.description: One-step purchase for products with instant checkout enabled (seller opt-in) and orders under bulk threshold. For products without instant checkout or larger orders, use request_quote instead.

tools.name: search_inventory_semantic
tools.description: Semantic catalog search: ranks listings by similarity to a natural-language description (e.g. 'something like AirPods but cheaper'). Returns the search_inventory product shape plus a similarity score in [0, 1]. No credentials needed.

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: Status, tracking and inspection deadline for an order owned by the authenticated buyer (X-MCP-API-Key of the order's buyer, or a buyer X-Agent-Token).

tools.name: open_dispute
tools.description: Open a dispute on a delivered order awaiting the buyer's confirmation. Moves the order to 'issue_reported', records the issue and notifies admins. Requires the order's buyer (X-MCP-API-Key or buyer X-Agent-Token).

tools.name: subscribe_to_query
tools.description: Save a search for the calling agent principal. New matching listings are sent to each channel: webhook (HMAC-signed POST), email, or a pollable resource at /api/mcp/resources/subscriptions/{id}. Requires credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: seller_inbox_summarise, open_dispute, subscribe_to_query · Private data: request_quote, get_quote_status, search_inventory_semantic, get_order_status, open_dispute, subscribe_to_query · Public sink: bulk_update_listings, bulk_mark_shipped, bulk_export_orders, subscribe_to_query · Destructive: seller_inbox_summarise.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: seller_inbox_summarise, open_dispute, subscribe_to_query · Private data: request_quote, get_quote_status, search_inventory_semantic, get_order_status, open_dispute, subscribe_to_query · Public sink: bulk_update_listings, bulk_mark_shipped, bulk_export_orders, subscribe_to_query · Destructive: seller_inbox_summarise

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
